## Summary by CodeRabbit

* **Chores**
  * Updated workflow to use a new test vectors repository and adjusted related paths.

## Walkthrough

The updates switch the test vector source from `jam-duna/jamtestnet` to `fluffylabs/test-vectors` throughout the workflow, scripts, and ignore files. Associated paths and environment variables are updated accordingly, and the `.gitignore` is revised to match the new directory structure. No changes are made to exported or public entities.

| bin/test-runner/jamduna.ts                      | Updated test vector path to `test-vectors/jamduna`, cleaned up accepted categories array.            |
